title: Diagnose an interrupted transfer
summary: Inspect an interrupted synthetic preparation and verify recovery before downloading.
prerequisites: Sign in as the synthetic docs-reviewer.
Use only the fixture interruption control; do not interrupt a live customer transfer.

steps.title: Prepare a test transfer
steps.instruction: Search sunrise, select the asset and prepare a download.

steps.title: Inspect interruption
steps.instruction: Choose Simulate interruption and inspect the transfer status and error.

steps.title: Resume the fixture transfer
steps.instruction: Restore the synthetic test connection by choosing Resume. Inspect the row before downloading.

expected: The transfer returns to Ready. This fixture does not prove native workstation copy or resumable browser-save behavior in Media Nexus.
recovery: If the transfer remains Interrupted, inspect the reported error and request review. Do not claim success until Ready is visible.
